semiconductor_relevance: High — Westlake Instruments specializes in equipment for silicon carbide substrate processing, which is critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Westlake Instruments (Hangzhou) Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the development and production of advanced equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly in silicon carbide substrate processing. The company has successfully integrated ultrafast laser processing technology into its product offerings, including laser lift-off equipment and slicing systems.
capabilities: Ultrafast laser processing technology for silicon carbide substrates
Laser lift-off equipment for silicon carbide
Laser slicing equipment for silicon carbide substrates
Irregular shape cutting for silicon carbide AR waveguides

regional_presence.China: Westlake Instruments is based in Hangzhou, China, and has achieved significant milestones in the domestic semiconductor equipment market.
